title: Put the rollout in order
summary: The stages between a trained model and full traffic.

items.text: Serve a small canary slice and watch errors and latency
Evaluate offline on a held-out, time-split dataset
Ramp to all traffic with a rollback plan
Run in shadow mode on live traffic without serving its results
Monitor drift and quality, and retrain on a schedule
Run an A/B test for a fixed duration on the primary metric
